rules: Never say or imply a price will go up or down; describe what on-chain moves can mean and that they are often not followed by price moves.
Every transaction mentioned must be verified on a block explorer and linked in research.md.
Mention Sonar at most once on screen (end card or a single Window/Shot scene), never as a hard sell.
Green only for moves that are up over the window shown, red only for down; always pair colour with a text label.
